backfill_duplicates_hint: Already-paid records for the same subscription and date are skipped. Existing payment amounts are preserved.
backfill_confirm: I checked the selected dates and amounts; these payments were made.
backfill_confirm_required: Review and confirm the past payment list.
backfill_empty: No payment dates have occurred yet for this start date and billing period.
backfill_invalid_schedule: Choose a valid start date and billing period.

setup_description: Restore a full backup or start a new installation.
setup_start_title: Do you have a full Monline backup?
setup_start_description: Restore your backup before creating an account, or start by creating the first administrator.
setup_new_install_description: Create the first administrator account and set your currency, budget, appearance and notifications.
setup_restore_description: Restore every account, subscription, payment, server setting, logo and uploaded file. Skip the setup steps and sign in with an account from the backup.
setup_restore_hint: .tar.gz or .tgz · up to 500 MiB. For account JSON backups, complete a new installation first, then use Import/Export.
setup_restore_progress: Validating and restoring the database and files. Keep this page open until the operation finishes.
setup_restore_full_required: Choose a full .tar.gz or .tgz instance backup exported from Monline. Account JSON and database-only .db files cannot be used here.
setup_restore_empty: This backup contains no accounts. Choose a full backup with an account or start a new installation.
setup_restore_invalid: The backup is invalid, incomplete or incompatible with this Monline version. Nothing was restored.
setup_restore_busy: A restore or database operation is in progress. Wait for it to finish and try again.
setup_restore_failed: The restore outcome could not be confirmed. Check the sign-in page before trying again; if restoration finished, use an account from the backup.
setup_account_description: The account you create during initial setup is the administrator account. It can manage server settings and full installation backups.
setup_defaults_description: Choose your main currency, monthly budget and appearance. You can change these later in Settings.
setup_notifications_description: Optionally configure SMTP for email reminders. You can skip this and enable it later in Settings.
setup_review_description: Check your information. Your account and initial configuration will be saved together when you finish.
setup_failed: The setup result could not be confirmed. Check your connection; if setup completed, sign in from the login page.
setup_already_complete: This instance already has an account. Please use the login page.
setup_status_failed: The server’s setup status could not be loaded. Check your connection and retry.
setup_password_max: Use a password of at most 72 UTF-8 bytes.
setup_budget_invalid: Enter a valid budget of zero or more.
setup_url_invalid: Enter the main server address starting with http:// or https://, without a path or query.
setup_smtp_optional: Enable to configure SMTP now. Email reminders will also be enabled for your account.
setup_smtp_test_recipient: The test email will be sent to the administrator address: {{email}}
setup_smtp_test_success: Test email sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.
setup_smtp_test_failed: Could not send the test email. Check the SMTP settings and sender address.
setup_smtp_test_auth_failed: SMTP authentication failed. Check the username and password.
setup_smtp_test_connection_failed: Could not connect to the SMTP server. Check the host, port, TLS and network access.
setup_smtp_test_rate_limit: Too many tests or a test is still running. Try again in a minute.
setup_preview: Setup preview. Existing accounts and settings are unchanged; finishing setup is disabled.
transfer_instance_export_description: Download the entire instance and its history in one backup file.
transfer_instance_description: All users, subscriptions, payment history, server settings, logos and uploaded files in one archive.
transfer_instance_scope: Includes all accounts and their history, registration/SMTP/OIDC settings, account security data, service keys, logos and attachments. Only the server administrator can create or restore this backup.
transfer_instance_limits: Archive limit: 500 MiB; up to 2 GiB expanded. Password hashes and 2FA configurations are included. Restoring signs out existing sessions.
transfer_instance_import_description: Choose an instance archive (.tar.gz), legacy database backup (.db) or account backup (.json). This flow handles the selected backup type.
transfer_instance_restore_note: This archive replaces every user’s data, server settings and uploaded files. A complete safety backup is saved on the server first. You must sign in again after restoration.
transfer_instance_legacy_note: This legacy .db backup replaces all database records and server settings while keeping current files. A full safety backup is made first. JSON account backups are merged into your own account only.
transfer_instance_too_large: The instance archive must not exceed 500 MiB.
transfer_instance_restore_failed: The instance restore result could not be confirmed. Refresh the page and try signing in again; invalid archives are not restored.
database_maintenance_description: An integrity check examines tables and indexes for problems. Optimization first backs up the database, reclaims space left by deleted records and updates query statistics. Your records are kept. Useful after deleting many records.
database_check_success: Database integrity checked. No problems found.
database_optimize_success: Database maintenance completed. The final integrity check also passed.
database_integrity_failed: An integrity problem was found. Optimization was skipped; back up the current database and investigate first.
database_postcheck_failed: The integrity check found a problem after maintenance. Keep the safety backup and investigate.
database_maintenance_busy: Another database operation is in progress. Try again shortly.
database_maintenance_disk_space: There is not enough free disk space for the backup and maintenance. Free some space and try again.
database_maintenance_failed: Database maintenance could not finish. Check the server’s disk space and file permissions.
database_maintenance_running: Operation in progress. Database writes may briefly wait.
database_safety_backup: The database safety backup is stored on the server: backups/{{file}}
database_checkpoint_busy: The database was in use, so the transaction log could not be fully reduced. Records remain safe; normal log processing will continue.
download_backup_desc: Downloads one .tar.gz archive containing all users, subscriptions, payment history, server settings, logos and uploaded files. Account export data is included. Maximum archive size: 500 MiB (2 GiB expanded).
restore_backup_desc: Restores the entire instance from a .tar.gz backup. A complete safety backup is saved on the server first. Legacy .db backups restore only the database and keep current uploaded files.
instance_restore_confirm: This replaces every user’s data, server settings and uploaded files. Everyone will be signed out. A complete safety backup will be saved on the server before restoration. Continue?
instance_restore_confirm_legacy: This legacy .db backup replaces every user’s database records and server settings. Current uploaded files will be kept. Everyone will be signed out. A complete safety backup will be saved on the server first. Continue?
instance_restore_success: Instance restored. Please sign in again.

delete_account_warning: This will permanently delete your account and all data. This cannot be undone.

profile_desc: Manage your personal information and preferences.

validation_nonnegative_integer: Enter a whole number of zero or greater.
reset_email_check: Check your email for the reset link.

reset_email_sent: Reset email sent! Check your inbox.
frequency_min: Frequency must be a whole number of at least 1
history_description: Compare the monthly cost of your recurring subscriptions. Current estimates and saved monthly snapshots are shown separately.
history_no_previous: No record for the previous month
history_comparison_pending: A consecutive month is needed to compare.
history_unchanged: Your monthly subscription cost is unchanged.
history_chart_label: Monthly equivalent subscription costs by recorded month
history_first_month: This is your first recorded month. Your current cost is visible below; comparison becomes available when another month is recorded.
history_table_caption: Up to 12 recorded months. Missing months are not counted as zero.
history_empty: No monthly cost data yet. Add a subscription to see its monthly equivalent here.
history_explain_estimate: The live estimate uses active expense subscriptions: yearly subscriptions are divided by 12, weekly subscriptions are converted to a monthly equivalent, and income credits are excluded. This is a recurring cost estimate, not the amount actually paid.
history_explain_snapshot: Past rows show the subscription cost saved for that month. The server saves a snapshot on the first day of each month; “Save this month” updates the current month. Past snapshots are not recalculated when a subscription changes. Values are displayed in your main currency; older snapshots retain their original numeric value, so avoid comparing across a change of main currency.
history_explain_gaps: Only recorded months are shown. A missing month is not zero spending. Changes are compared only with the immediately preceding calendar month. No percentage is shown when the previous value was zero.
history_load_error: Saved history could not be loaded. The live estimate may still be available. Refresh the page to retry.
history_save_error: This month could not be saved. Please retry.
theme_save_error: Could not save your theme. Please retry.
budget_month_empty: No subscription charges are due this month.
budget_list_error: This month’s payments could not be loaded. Refresh to retry.
budget_month_note: Charges are grouped by their due month. Paid amounts come from payment records; other amounts are scheduled prices, converted to your main currency.
payments_load_error: Payment data could not be loaded. Refresh to retry.
payments_month_empty: There are no recorded payments in {{month}}. Select Planned to see scheduled charges.
payments_missing_amount: {{count}} payments have no recorded amount and are excluded from the total.
payments_paid_note: Paid totals use recorded amounts and payment dates. Income is excluded; currency conversion uses current rates.
statistics_payments_description: See costs by category and select a month to see which subscriptions were paid.
payments_month_unpriced: Payment records in {{month}} have no recorded amounts.
statistics_category_period_note: Estimated total for subscription charges due in the selected months, using current prices.
calendar_history_range_hint: Past payments can only be added for dates between today and one year ago.
historical_description: Record a subscription payment made within the past year. The subscription's next payment date stays the same.
historical_dates_hint: Both dates must be within the past year. If you paid late, choose the original due date separately. Statistics use the payment date; the calendar and budget use the due date.
historical_no_subscriptions: Add a subscription first. You can record past payments for active and inactive subscriptions.
historical_duplicate: This subscription already has a paid record for the selected due date.
historical_invalid_date: Choose a valid date between today and one year ago.
historical_invalid_amount: Enter a valid payment amount of zero or more.
historical_invalid_notes: Notes must be at most 2000 characters.
historical_save_failed: Could not save the payment. Check the details and your connection, then try again.
statistics_category_paid_note: Recorded payment amounts are grouped by the date paid. The subscription's current category and current exchange rate are used; income is excluded.
statistics_category_fixed_share_note: For fixed monthly subscriptions, a longer period increases totals and payment counts while category percentages may stay the same.
statistics_category_zero_amount: Recorded payments in this period total zero.
statistics_category_no_payments: No payments with recorded amounts in this period. You can add past payments in the calendar.
statistics_category_breakdown: Category amounts and shares for the selected period
statistics_category_unassigned_note: {{count}} subscriptions in this calculation have no category. They share one group, so the chart can remain at 100% even when totals change. Expand a category row to see subscription amounts.
statistics_category_assign: Open subscriptions and assign categories in the editor
transfer_export_description: Download all your account data and histories in one backup file.
transfer_backup_description: Subscriptions, payment and price histories, monthly costs, settings, logos, and payment attachments in one JSON file.
transfer_scope: Includes active/inactive subscriptions and income, all recorded payments, price and status changes, monthly cost history, categories, people, payment methods, currencies, account preferences, notification settings, and notification history.
transfer_secrets_excluded: Only your account is exported. Passwords, sessions, 2FA information, API/notification keys, and server administration settings are excluded. Full backups are limited to 100 MB.
transfer_import_description: Choose a full Monline backup to restore records, histories, attachments, and account settings together.
transfer_merge_note: All backup datasets and account settings are imported together. Existing financial records are kept; missing records are added with their relationships and histories. Service credentials must be entered again.
transfer_import_result: {{imported}} records imported; {{skipped}} existing records skipped. Account settings were restored too.
transfer_invalid_backup: Choose a valid full Monline JSON backup. Legacy subscription-only files and backups with missing attachments cannot be used in this flow.
transfer_too_large: Backup size limit exceeded: JSON up to 100 MB, attachments up to 64 MB in total and 12 MB per file.
transfer_file_failed: A logo or payment attachment could not be downloaded. No incomplete backup was created; please retry.
transfer_export_failed: Export could not be completed. Check the server connection and retry.
transfer_import_failed: Import could not be completed. Full account backup imports are rolled back without adding partial records.
payments_upcoming_sentence: {{count}} subscriptions have upcoming payments totaling {{amount}} in {{month}}.
payments_upcoming_note: Shows unpaid upcoming charges from today onward, starting at each subscription’s next payment date. Paid charges, past dates, inactive subscriptions, and income are excluded. Amounts use current prices and exchange rates.
remember_login_hint: Keep me signed in on this browser for 30 days.
bulk_edit_hint: Edit each selected item, then save the changes together.
bulk_partial_failure: {{count}} items could not be processed. Your selection has been kept so you can retry.
statistics_category_no_upcoming: No upcoming payments in the selected period.
calendar_delete_payment_confirm: This payment record will be permanently deleted. The subscription and other payments will be kept. Are you sure?
calendar_delete_failed: Could not complete deletion. Please try again.
calendar_clear_confirm: Permanently delete all {{payments}} subscription payment records from your account, across all dates? Subscriptions, the statement archive and income entries will be kept. This cannot be undone. Are you sure? Scheduled upcoming payments will still appear on the calendar.
